    safety and quality standards.

• Analyzed power load curves, prepared Daily Generation Reports, and contributed to wind

• Troubleshot DFIG converters and IGBT switch controls, minimizing downtime and 

optimizing WTG performance.

▪ Maintenance of transformers (rewinding, Varnishing, coil checking)
